findings.title: WSL-only PATH fallback is accepted
findings.failure_mechanism: When both fixed Git-for-Windows candidates are unavailable, generic shutil.which("bash") is accepted without rejecting the known Windows WSL launcher.
findings.violated_invariant: A WSL launcher must not satisfy the Git-for-Windows trusted-runner host contract.
required_remediation: Define positive suitability for PATH fallback OR remove fallback.
Regression: fixed Git Bash absent; PATH resolves to C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe; require deterministic failure.

findings.title: Public verification-gate is skipped rather than failed after Windows prerequisite failure
findings.failure_mechanism: Without fail-closed downstream execution/result checking, failure, cancellation or skipping of windows-trusted-runner may skip the dependent public verification-gate rather than explicitly failing. This is unsafe for the intended future Required Check boundary; this report does not assert hosting controls are configured.
findings.violated_invariant: verification-gate must report failure whenever native Windows validation does not complete successfully.
required_remediation: Run the public gate after the prerequisite terminal result using fail-safe semantics, e.g. always().
Make failure, cancellation, skip and timeout fail the public gate.
Add workflow-level regressions or controlled evidence for those outcomes.

findings.title: Apostrophe-containing native Windows paths are silently altered
findings.failure_mechanism: An apostrophe-containing native Windows path is transported incorrectly before/at the Git-Bash conversion boundary.
findings.violated_invariant: Transport must preserve arbitrary valid Windows path characters without shell injection.
required_remediation: Use transport preserving arbitrary valid Windows path characters.
Add real/native regression for apostrophe-containing paths.
